inlines.v: CONSTIPATE, verb transitive [Latin , to crowd, or cram. See Stuff and Stop.] 1. To crowd or cram into a narrow compass; to thicken or condense. 2. To stop, by filling a passage, and preventing motion; as, to constipate capillary vessels. 3. To fill or crowd the intestinal canal, and make costive.
